claude-opus-5.reason: Diagnostic comparison series of twelve PATZ1-fused CNS tumours against extra-CNS sarcomas with DNA-methylation profiling in human tissue and reported diagnostic specificity for GATA2.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: Descriptive case series of twelve CNS PATZ1-fused tumors characterizing a newly recognized tumor entity, without a designed comparison cohort.

claude-opus-5.reason: Case-control comparison of directly measured chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq) in Treg cells from acute urticaria patients versus healthy controls, framed as diagnostic and prognostic biomarker discovery.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility was compared between Treg cells from urticaria patients and controls, but the analysis is mechanistic and not tied to a stated exposure or clinical decision.

claude-opus-5.reason: DNA methylation of lncRNA genes was measured in human breast tumour samples, but the abstract states no analytic design and no clear comparison group or clinical decision link.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: DNA co-methylation among lncRNA genes was measured in breast tumor samples, but the study characterizes a regulatory network without linking it to an exposure or clinical decision.

claude-opus-5.reason: THBD hypermethylation is reported only from web-based portal analyses, and the abstract does not make clear whether individual-level data or only database-level aggregates were analysed.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: THBD promoter hypermethylation was measured in UCEC tissue via public databases, but it showed no significant survival association and no exposure link was tested.

claude-opus-5.reason: Bioinformatic driver-gene framework applied to TCGA methylation and expression data with no analytic study design stated for the patient cohorts.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: The Moonlight2 framework applies individual-level TCGA DNA methylation data to identify driver genes with prognostic (survival) significance in three cancer subtypes.

claude-opus-5.reason: The human case-control analysed only genotype, and the abstract does not say in what material the cis-regulatory and ChIP-seq chromatin work was performed.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: The human case-control arm genotypes an enhancer SNP (rs10223516); the ChIP-seq/RNA-seq evidence for FOXP4 regulation was generated in cell-line functional assays, not measured as a marker in the patient cohort.

claude-opus-5.reason: A DNA methylation microarray was run on patient tumours but only copy number outputs were compared, leaving it unclear whether a methylation marker itself was linked to the diagnostic decision.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: DNA methylation microarray data are used only to infer chromosomal copy-number variation in this assay-comparison study; no methylation status itself is analyzed or reported.

claude-opus-5.reason: Urinary cell-free DNA from healthy, pregnant, chronic kidney disease and bladder cancer participants was sequenced, with hypomethylation signals used for cancer detection.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: Urinary cell-free DNA fragments are overlapped with pre-existing reference open-chromatin/heterochromatin annotations rather than directly assaying chromatin state in the study participants.

claude-opus-5.reason: Retrospective tumour series correlated B7-H3 expression with epigenetic subclass, but the abstract does not state whether DNA methylation was measured in this study.

claude-sonnet-5.reason: The study measures B7-H3 mRNA and protein expression by IHC; existing epigenetic subclass labels are used only as a covariate, not measured here.
